messages.text: Map the chain from a Automotive market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Vector Network Analyzer.

| Automotive market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required VNA capability |
|---|---|---|
| Automotive radar testing needs dynamic artificial object generation, supported by the R&S AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator. [35] | Suppression of ghost objects is measured from IF input to IF output connector at the AREG800A base unit and is specified as `> 40 dBc (meas.)`. [28] | The VNA must support time-domain measurement, because the suppression of ghost objects condition states “vector network analyzer in time domain.” [28] |
| Automotive radar echo generation must support FMCW radar in digital mode, with maximum generated distance up to `3000 m`. [60] | The ghost-object measurement uses distance to wanted artificial object of `2 m` and spans of `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`, `0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`, or `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz`. [28] | The VNA must support the required frequency span and sweep settings, including frequency step size `125 kHz`, measurement bandwidth `100 kHz`, and source power `–10 dBm`. [28] |
| Automotive radar production configurations include one, two, or three digital channels depending on AREG-P1, AREG-P2, or AREG-P3. [30] | Dynamic RCS range is `90 dB` for all artificial objects on one IF path with AREG8-24S / AREG8-24D / AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D, and `> 60 dB` with QAT100. [29] | The VNA measurement condition for these level and IF transfer characteristics requires frequency step size `2.5 MHz`, measurement bandwidth `1 kHz`, source power `–10 dBm`, and the listed spans. [29] |
| Automotive radar production configurations include one object per channel in AREG-P1 and AREG-P3. [30] | RCS control step size is `0.1 dB`. [29] | The VNA setup for associated IF transfer characterization must support the stated sweep step, bandwidth, source power, and span conditions. [29] |
【推論】For the ghost-object chain, the VNA capability maps most directly to time-domain analysis, and R&S ZNA provides the R&S ZNA-K2 Time domain analysis option. [11], [28]

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

[60] | The ghost-object measurement uses distance to wanted artificial object of `2 m` and spans of `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`, `0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`, or `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz`. [28] | The VNA must support the required frequency span and sweep settings, including frequency step size `125 kHz`, measurement bandwidth `100 kHz`, and source power `–10 dBm`. [28] |
| Automotive radar production configurations include one, two, or three digital channels depending on AREG-P1, AREG-P2, or AREG-P3. [30] | Dynamic RCS range is `90 dB` for all artificial objects on one IF path with AREG8-24S / AREG8-24D / AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D, and `> 60 dB` with QAT100. [29] | The VNA measurement condition for these level and IF transfer characteristics requires frequency step size `2.5 MHz`, measurement bandwidth `1 kHz`, source power `–10 dBm`, and the listed spans. [29] |
